description: This file defines a PHP class 'NationalityFixture' which extends 'AbstractFixture'. It is used within the testing suite of the OrangeHRM HRM system to set up fixture data for nationalities, retrieving data from the database and formatting it for test purposes.

classes.name: NationalityFixture
classes.description: A PHPUnit fixture class used to load nationality data for testing purposes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves all nationality entities from the database and formats them into an array suitable for fixture loading.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with this fixture, 'Nationality.yaml', for use in test data.
